runners_data.name: Suitcase Smith
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner gives huge tactical advantage but must prove stamina after 36-day break

races.paceDynamic: Suitcase Smith is the only confirmed pace-setter in this field of predominantly hold-up horses, giving him an uncontested lead from the start. With ten hold-up runners behind him, Smith can dictate a steady tempo without early pressure, creating a tactical advantage at Yarmouth's tight turns. The large pack of hold-up horses will bunch up behind the leader, setting up a frantic sprint finish as they all come with late runs simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the crowded field of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Suitcase Smith gets an easy lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: Smith dictates perfect fractions without pressure, then holds off the late charge as hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind. The tactical advantage of clear running proves decisive over superior ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Bunch Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses navigate traffic cleanly
scenarios.body: Smith leads but gets swamped in the final furlong as multiple hold-up horses unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. Superior class and recent form tell in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Smith Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Suitcase Smith's 36-day break shows and he weakens
scenarios.body: The leader cracks before the furlong pole, leaving the hold-up horses to sort it out in a messy sprint. The best recent form and strongest finishers benefit from the collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get severely hampered
scenarios.body: Poor draws and bunching create carnage in the straight, allowing a horse with luck in running to capitalize. Those drawn wide or getting early position prosper.

races.paceDynamic: Almaty Star and Twilight Fun will contest the early lead, with both habitual front-runners likely to go forward from the gate. This creates an honest gallop over the straight five furlongs, with the prominent runners like Kinswoman, Naana's Sparkle, and Grandlad tracking just behind the leaders. The hold-up horses including Nogo's Dream, Existent, and Rocking Ends face a difficult task given the limited time and distance to make up ground. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and kick when it matters, as they avoid the risks of both battling for the lead and needing too much late ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Favours Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders settle into a sustainable rhythm without killing each other
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect setup to strike in the final furlong, with those tracking closest having the tactical advantage. Kinswoman and Naana's Sparkle are ideally positioned to exploit this scenario given their style and class.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Duel Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Almaty Star and Twilight Fun engage in a fierce early battle and weaken each other
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing the hold-up horses to storm through late. Nogo's Dream and Rocking Ends have the class to capitalize if given this opportunity.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Wire
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Almaty Star proves strongest of the pace-setters and has enough left to hold off all challengers. His recent Yarmouth win over course and distance makes this a live possibility.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Suits Mid-Division
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is neither too fast nor too slow, creating a muddling gallop
scenarios.body: The versatile prominent runners who can adapt their position get the best of both worlds. Michaela's Boy and Grandlad can adjust tactics to suit the evolving race dynamics.

runners_data.name: Butterfly Beach
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 172 days off but has solid course form and the pace setup suits her closing style perfectly

races.paceDynamic: Creative Queen will lead unopposed from the start with Viviana likely tracking her in second position down the back straight. The lack of early pace pressure means Creative Queen can dictate terms and control fractions through the first half-mile. With only one genuine front-runner, the pace will be genuine but manageable, setting up a finish where stamina and tactical positioning become crucial over raw early speed. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Reigning Queen and Butterfly Beach who can benefit from the controlled tempo and finish fastest when the pace lifts in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Creative Queen sets steady fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The controlled tempo allows closers to conserve energy and unleash their best finishing kick when the pace inevitably quickens approaching the final furlong. Both Reigning Queen and Butterfly Beach can position perfectly off the moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner controls completely
scenarios.trigger: If Creative Queen maintains her lead without serious challenge through halfway
scenarios.body: She dictates comfortable sectionals throughout and has enough left to repel late challenges, with Viviana providing the main threat from her stalking position. The lack of sustained pressure allows the leader to stay strong late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mystery newcomer strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Harvest shows significant improvement on debut
scenarios.body: The unknown quantity exploits the steady pace setup to deliver a performance well above expectations from either prominent or hold-up tactics. Creative Queen's honest pace sets up the perfect scenario for a well-handicapped newcomer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse applies meaningful pressure to Creative Queen through 4 furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the 2-furlong pole where pure acceleration matters most regardless of running style. This tactical scramble could favour any horse with a sharp turn of foot.

runners_data.name: Shimmering Spin
runners_data.note: Front-running type wearing cheekpieces but faces tactical nightmare with entire field behind him.

races.paceDynamic: Shimmering Spin is the lone confirmed front-runner and will dictate a sustainable early gallop without pressure from gate to home. With Physique, Potomac River, and Noble Guest sitting prominent but unlikely to challenge for the lead, the pace will be honest but not destructive. The majority field - Beagle Bay, Fifty Nifty, Berry Clever, Anthropologist, and the absent Believe The Storm - are all hold-up merchants who will be tracking from midfield and beyond. This tactical setup creates a perfect storm for closers, as the uncontested leader will face a wall of finishers in the straight with superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get the right splits and momentum turning for home
scenarios.body: Shimmering Spin's lack of pace pressure early means the closing brigade gets ideal racing conditions with a sitting target to reel in. The sheer weight of numbers (six hold-up runners) means several will get clear runs to overhaul the tiring leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Physique or Noble Guest can secure ideal positions behind the leader without using energy
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced pair get first run on the weakening Shimmering Spin while the hold-up horses are still finding their stride. Their tactical advantage of racing closer allows them to capitalize before the back-markers arrive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Shimmering Spin gets soft sectionals and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The uncontested front-runner builds an unassailable advantage through gentle early fractions then finds another gear when it matters. The hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up despite their superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Shimmering Spin goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in a bunch finish where the best horse on the day prevails regardless of tactics. Class and current form become the decisive factors rather than running style advantages.

races.paceDynamic: Victor Cee will take this race up as the sole confirmed leader, with Koffee And Kale, U S S Charleston, Staniel Cay, Grey Horizon, and Loleeta all prominent racers likely to track him closely in the early stages. With five prominent runners and only one hold-up horse (London Is Blue), this creates a compressed field behind Victor Cee over this minimum trip. The pace should be reasonable rather than fierce given Victor Cee won't face immediate pressure, but the sheer weight of numbers tracking means the race will quicken sharply from the 2f pole. This race shape favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and finish, as London Is Blue faces a near-impossible task from the rear in a small field over 5f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front End
scenarios.trigger: If Victor Cee dictates fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and the prominent pack has to come around him late, but the response may come too late over this sharp trip. Front-running tactics prove most effective when the pace isn't collapsed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply gradual pressure to Victor Cee from halfway
scenarios.body: The pace lifts steadily and those with the best tactical speed can strike approaching the final furlong, overwhelming the leader. Superior class tells in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Positioning Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners jostle for position behind Victor Cee early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens sooner than ideal and those who secure the smoothest passage gain a decisive advantage. Racing room becomes crucial in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the first 3f
scenarios.body: London Is Blue gets the perfect setup to unleash a sustained finish from the rear, catching the field napping. The prominent runners pay for conservative early positioning.
